item.title: As Trump’s Midterm Deadline Looms, Gulf Countries Brace for Possible Renewal of Iran War
item.description: The energy-rich Gulf Arab countries are engaged in a flurry of mediation efforts to avert war between the U.S. and Iran, as many fear that the fighting will be worse this time around.

item.title: King Charles Says U.K.’s Role in Slave Trade ‘Fills My Heart With Horror’
item.description: The monarch called Britain’s trafficking of enslaved people from Africa a “shameful chapter of history” at a meeting of Commonwealth heads of government in Antigua.
